files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed
- **Opaque sort/filter dropdown menu, no automatic scan banner on page load/reload, and pixel-centered action button icons** ([#206](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/206)). Gave the sort and filter dropdown next to the search bar (as well as sidebar and toolbar popups) a solid opaque surface, stronger elevation shadow, and `z-index: 2000` stacking context so underlying sidebar items never bleed through in dark or translucent themes; prevented visiting or reloading the page from automatically showing the scan progress banner or activating interactive scan status during background cron runs, while persisting cleared stale states and registering a PHP shutdown handler so interrupted scans always mark completion cleanly; and centered all action button icons (`Open Folder`, `Open File`, `Keep Folder`, `Delete`, and `Protected`) with even `16x16` SVG dimensions, balanced `viewBox` coordinates, and explicit flex/margin resets
